territories.name: Vanuatu
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Vanuatu levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 247]: the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue administers it at 15 per cent, the Act zero-rates exports and the other supplies of its Schedule 3 and exempts those of its Schedule 1, and a registered person files a monthly or, under eight million vatu of supplies, a three-monthly return.
